{{Quote|In fact, when ‘Emperor’ Palpatine decided to arrest me for treason, one of his lapdog Senators informed Bail beforehand. Bail, while pretending to gloat with the swine, sent one of his men to warn me. I got off-planet about two minutes ahead of the ISB agents.|Mon Mothma|<ref name="RA" />}}
A '''male''' was associated with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="RA" /> In approximately [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' states that [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] [[Mon Mothma's escape from Coruscant|escaped]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the signing of the [[Corellian Treaty]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].</ref> [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] decided to arrest Senator [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] for [[Treason/Legends|treason]],<ref name="RA" /> which carried a [[Death/Legends|death]] sentence,<ref name="Fact File 36">{{FactFile|36|MOT 1-4|Mon Mothma}}</ref> for her clandestine efforts to develop a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebellion]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TFU guide">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Organa learned of the arrest through a [[Unidentified senator (Bail Organa)|loyalist senator]], and while pretending to gloat, he sent the man to warn Mothma.<ref name="RA" /> A [[Unidentified bodyguard|bodyguard]] spirited the [[Chandrilan/Legends|Chandrilan]] to safety,<ref name="TFU guide" /> and Mothma was able to [[Mon Mothma's escape from Coruscant|escape]]<ref name="RA" /> the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> mere [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] before agents of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] arrived to arrest her.<ref name="RA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bail Organa's man was mentioned in ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'' written by [[Paul Murphy]] and published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' in [[1990]].<ref name="RA" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], as portrayed in "[[Welcome to the Rebellion]],"<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion">{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}}</ref> the ninth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']]&mdash;which debuted on on [[May 6]], [[2025]]<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>&mdash;[[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] sent a team of three: [[Beska]], [[Charval]], and [[Selko]], to help [[Mon Mothma]] [[Escape from the Senate|escape]] from the Senate following a speech denouncing the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]] for the [[Ghorman Massacre]]. However, Mothma was accurately warned beforehand by her ally [[Luthen Rael]] that Organa's team could not be trusted, as Beska was an [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[spy]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />
